rationale: OC-ONT wave. (1) `imports`: `#import`/`#include` is the language's only dependency declaration and was published as `references` + metadata.isObjCImport, invisible to the LSP usages file-level section which filters relationship_type='imports' with a NULL symbol endpoint on both sides. The `references` twin is kept because the F5 oracle derives `references` for preproc_include. (2) `exports`: external linkage (C99 6.2.2p5, inherited verbatim) is Objective-C's export construct; `static` is internal linkage and is NOT exported. Pre-fix, 50 file-scope function_definitions and 67 file-scope declarations carrying `static` across the pinned corpus were published visibility:"public". (3) `[[self alloc] init]` instantiates the RECEIVER'S OWN CLASS; pre-fix it published `instantiates <method> -> self`, 24 of 507 corpus edges (4.7%), naming the `self` keyword.
